title: No critical alerts firing
hint: Observe > Alerting in the console; follow the alert runbook

title: AnsibleAutomationPlatform CR reconciled
hint: oc describe ansibleautomationplatform aap -n aap; check the operator logs

title: Recent successful platform backup
hint: Backups older than a day mean the backup schedule is not running

title: No CrashLoopBackOff / image pull errors
hint: oc logs --previous <pod>; check image pull secrets

title: AAP operator CSV Succeeded
hint: oc get csv -n aap; check the install plan

title: AAP pods Running and Ready
hint: oc describe pod <name> -n aap

title: PersistentVolumeClaims Bound
hint: oc describe pvc -n aap; check the storage class / provisioner

title: Route TLS certificates not expiring
hint: python/28_aap_ssl_certificate_scanner.py; rotate the route / ingress certificate

title: Deployments and StatefulSets at desired replicas
hint: oc get deploy,sts -n aap

title: etcd members running
hint: oc rsh -n openshift-etcd <pod> etcdctl endpoint health

title: etcd operator healthy
hint: oc get pods -n openshift-etcd; check member health

title: Nodes Ready
hint: oc describe node <name>; oc adm top nodes

title: ClusterOperators Available and not Degraded
hint: oc get co; oc describe co <name>

title: ClusterVersion Available, not Failing
hint: oc adm upgrade; oc describe clusterversion

title: No alerts firing in the AAP namespace
hint: Observe > Alerting filtered to namespace aap

title: Component CRs reconciled (controller, EDA, hub)
hint: Check the component operator pod logs in aap

title: Containers below memory limit
hint: Red Hat: capacity does not introspect host resources - watch CPU/memory and raise limits

title: No OOMKilled containers (24h)
hint: Raise the memory limit in the CR (*_resource_requirements)

title: PVC free space (database, hub, redis)
hint: Expand the PVC (storage class must allow expansion); run cleanup management jobs

title: ResourceQuota headroom
hint: Job pods fail to schedule when the quota is exhausted

title: Pod restarts since last run
hint: Restarts are counted against the previous daily snapshot

title: Routes admitted by the ingress controller
hint: oc describe route -n aap

title: etcd WAL fsync p99 < 10 ms
detail: Red Hat: p99 of etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds should be below 10 ms
hint: Move etcd to faster (NVMe/SSD) dedicated disks

title: etcd leader stable (24h)
detail: etcd_server_leader_changes_seen_total; frequent elections point at disk or network latency
hint: Investigate etcd disk and network latency

title: MachineConfigPools updated, not Degraded
hint: oc get mcp; oc describe mcp <pool>

title: Node CPU and memory headroom
hint: Nodes need spare capacity for pod rescheduling during upgrades

title: No Memory/Disk/PID pressure on nodes
hint: Pressure triggers pod eviction - free disk / memory on the node

title: AAP pods not CPU throttled (1h)
hint: Raise CPU requests/limits (Red Hat observed PostgreSQL throttling below 500m requests)

title: Warning events in namespace (24h)
hint: oc get events -n aap --field-selector type=Warning

title: Operator update pending approval
detail: installed aap-operator.v2.6.0-0.1761234567, channel stable-2.6, approval Manual
hint: Review and approve the InstallPlan in a change window

title: PodDisruptionBudgets allow node drains
hint: A PDB with 0 allowed disruptions stalls MachineConfigPool rollouts during upgrades

title: Replicas spread across worker nodes
detail: multi-replica workloads span more than one node
hint: Red Hat recommends topology_spread_constraints so one node loss does not take out a component

title: Controller task containers have resource limits
hint: Control capacity is derived from the task container limits; set task_resource_requirements

title: No pending certificate signing requests
hint: oc get csr; approve legitimate node CSRs (oc adm certificate approve)

title: etcd backend commit p99
hint: Check disk bandwidth on control plane nodes

title: etcd peer round trip p99 < 50 ms
detail: Red Hat: etcd_network_peer_round_trip_time_seconds p99 should be below 50 ms
hint: Check control plane network latency

title: No nodes left cordoned
hint: oc adm uncordon <node> after maintenance
